# Ollama provenance

- Project: Ollama
- Upstream: https://github.com/ollama/ollama
- License: MIT
- MALENJO integration: fixed loopback HTTP API through the native Rust boundary
- Binary vendored in this repository: no
- Model weights vendored in this repository: no
- Automatic model download from the chat workspace: no

Phase 5 discovers already-installed models from a local Ollama runtime and uses local chat generation. MALENJO does not redistribute Ollama binaries or model weights.

Model licenses are independent of the Ollama runtime license and must be reviewed per model before redistribution or institutional deployment.
